journey.title: Tab out of the departure date to the passengers field
journey.goal: Tab moves focus from the date field to the next field, as in any form

functionalJourney.title: Change the passengers with the pointer
functionalJourney.goal: Editing another field and saving submits the saved departure date

guards.title: Escape still closes the calendar
guards.goal: With the calendar open, Escape closes it and Tab then reaches the passengers field

guards.title: Clicking the date field still shows the calendar
guards.goal: A pointer user who clicks the departure date sees the month and can pick a day

plan.root_cause: The datepicker component prevents the default action of the Tab keydown event on the input element, preventing focus from moving to the next field. This occurs because the datepicker's internal logic (likely from Vanilla Calendar Pro) captures the Tab key to manage calendar navigation, but fails to reset the state properly when tabbing out.
plan.repair_strategy: Add a keydown listener to the datepicker input element that specifically handles the Tab key by hiding the datepicker popup without preventing the default action. This allows the Tab key to proceed normally while ensuring the datepicker is closed when focus leaves the input.

plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Tab key navigation will move focus from the departure date field to the passengers field as expected, restoring logical tab order for keyboard users.
functional_risks: The datepicker may not hide correctly if the Tab key is pressed while the calendar is open but focus remains within the datepicker popup (e.g., when navigating the calendar with Tab).
Adding the keydown listener could potentially conflict with other custom keyboard handlers attached to the input element.
If the datepicker is shown programmatically (not via user interaction), the Tab key listener might hide it prematurely.
verification_requirements: Verify that pressing Tab from the departure date field moves focus to the passengers field.
Verify that pressing Shift+Tab from the passengers field moves focus back to the departure date field.
Verify that the datepicker popup closes when tabbing out of the departure date field.
Verify that date selection via mouse or keyboard still functions correctly.
Verify that the datepicker does not interfere with Tab navigation in other form fields.

plan.root_cause: The vanilla-calendar-pro (VCP) library attaches a keydown listener to the date input during its init() call that prevents the default action on Tab key, blocking focus movement to the next form field. Bootstrap's datepicker wrapper initializes VCP before adding any custom keyboard handlers, so VCP's listener runs first and calls preventDefault().
plan.repair_strategy: Add a keydown listener on the date input BEFORE calling VCP's init(), so it registers first. On Tab key, hide the datepicker and call stopImmediatePropagation() to prevent VCP's listener from running, while allowing the default tab navigation to proceed. Clean up the listener on dispose.

plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Tab key navigation will move focus from the departure date field to the passengers field as expected, restoring logical tab order for keyboard users. The datepicker popup closes when tabbing out.
functional_risks: If VCP changes its internal event handling in a future version, the stopImmediatePropagation approach may need adjustment.
The datepicker may not hide correctly if the Tab key is pressed while focus remains within the datepicker popup (e.g., when navigating the calendar with Tab).
Adding the keydown listener before VCP init could potentially conflict with other custom keyboard handlers attached to the input element.
verification_requirements: Verify that pressing Tab from the departure date field moves focus to the passengers field.
Verify that pressing Shift+Tab from the passengers field moves focus back to the departure date field.
Verify that the datepicker popup closes when tabbing out of the departure date field.
Verify that date selection via mouse or keyboard still functions correctly.
Verify that the datepicker does not interfere with Tab navigation in other form fields.
